I will keep my land in the wheat-maize cycle this year. In Quzhou County, that is the most familiar and steady way for me to farm, and at my age I want something I know well, can manage with ordinary machinery, and can sell easily. Since it is already the start of the growing season, my winter wheat is already in the field, so I will finish managing that crop through spring and early summer, then I will plant summer maize right after harvest on the same land. I will not split into too many crops because that makes field work, fertilizer use, and pest control harder for me. I will use improved wheat seed and hybrid maize seed, put most of the fertilizer into these two grain crops, irrigate wheat more carefully because spring water matters for yield, and keep maize management simple with timely sowing, one main topdressing, and basic pest control. I will use machinery where I can and keep the plan practical rather than complicated.
